bone_keys_hint: Moves the bone over what the clips do with it. It is edited while keys are recorded: a field or the gizmo then keys it at the playhead. The key button takes the keys of that part away.
key_picked: Key what is picked where the playhead is (K): a bone whole, or where an attachment is placed and its animated fields
weight_hint: Keys a curve for how much the clip counts, on top of its fades, which the curve editor shapes. It moves with the clip.
windows: When it hangs on the model
windows_hint: Each stretch is a block on the timeline in the attachment's group: drag or trim it; right-click a block to split it where you clicked, right-click the empty lane to add one. An empty "taken off" is the end of the montage.
broken_file: This montage could not be read:
event_hint: Scripts react to it: onEvent("name") on the montage's handle.
fade_hint: Drag the dot on the top edge of a block to fade it. A clip fading in blends over what is under it: the clip that started before it, or what the entity plays beneath the montage. Drag a block up or down to put it on another row.
loop_hint: Start the clip over when it runs out before the block does, instead of holding its last frame
mask_hint: Which bones the clip moves, separated by commas; !name leaves one out. Empty is every bone.
model_attachment_hint: This hangs on the model in its rig. Changing it here makes the montage bring its own copy, which takes its place while the montage plays.
no_clips: The preview model has no clips
no_preview_model: Pick a preview model in the inspector: the montage plays on any model with the same bones and clips.
preview_model_hint: Only what the editor shows the montage on; in the game it plays on whatever model the entity has.
